newsitem.title: CHINA: Chinese steel producer seen in HK$1.7 bln float.
newsitem.headline: Chinese steel producer seen in HK$1.7 bln float.

text.p: Chinese steel producer Angang New Steel Co Ltd is expected to raise HK$1.7 billion by issuing about 890 million H-shares in an initial public offering (IPO) of shares later in July, market sources said on Friday.
Sources said the new shares were expected to be issued at a price ranging from HK$1.61 to HK$1.97 each, giving a price to earnings multiple of 7.9 to 9.5 times on a fully-diluted basis.
"It is likely to be the first H-share to be listed after Hong Kong reverted to Chinese rule," one source said.
H-shares are the shares of Chinese-incorporated firms listed in Hong Kong.
Sources said ING Barings was expected to be the sponsor of the issue.
No further listing details were immediately available to the market.
The steel producer is expected to hold a presentation for analysts on Wednesday, sources said.
